label: CSM-v1
summary: Shared-capital cross-sectional momentum: rank the nine assets by 180-bar momentum at 00:00 UTC, hold the top 3 equally, rebalance atomically at the common open. No stop, no blocked reentry.

states.evidence: Multi-asset engine, spec and multi-asset-protocol-v1 committed (2c3bce7, research/platform). Baseline, execution-cost stress (1x/1.5x/2x), parameter stability (120/180/240 x top 2/3/4) and temporal diagnostics have been run and reviewed for this spec. None of them is persisted as a result artefact in the lab repository, so this dashboard has no dataset to render.
